disclaimer: Screening-level physical scenario simulation. Landslide 'detections' are model candidates, not confirmed field observations, and are not a certified warning service.
model: Transient infiltration + infinite-slope FS + Voellmy D8 runout (NER calibration v2.0)

profile.terrain_note: Teesta valley flank of the Sikkim Himalaya; 550-2160 m relief, glaciated headwaters.
profile.regolith: Weathered phyllite / Darjeeling gneiss colluvium with thin glacial till veneer.
profile.threshold_source: Caine (1980) global intensity-duration envelope, regionally scaled
notes: Monsoon-dominated; 2023 South Lhonak GLOF and recurrent NH10 slope failures.
Deep colluvium on 30-40 deg benches is the dominant translational-slide setting.
